replies.task: What is the capital of Portugal?
replies.text:
The capital of Portugal is Lisbon. It is located in the western part of the country along the Tagus River and serves as the nation's primary center for politics, culture, commerce, and transportation.

replies.task: How many days are in February in a leap year?
replies.text:
In a leap year, February has 29 days. This extra day is added to keep our calendar year synchronized with the astronomical year (the time it takes Earth to orbit the Sun). In non-leap years, February only has 28 days.

DONE

replies.task: Name a programming language created at Bell Labs.
replies.text:
One prominent programming language created at Bell Labs is **C**. It was developed in 1972 by Dennis Ritchie and Ken Thompson for the UNIX operating system. Other notable languages or technologies from Bell Labs include AWK, SNOBOL4, and later contributions to Java (specifically the development of the JVM) and Python (Guido van Rossum worked there briefly).

DONE

replies.text: HTTP stands for Hypertext Transfer Protocol. It is an application-layer protocol used for distributed, collaborative, hypermedia systems like the World Wide Web. DONE

replies.task: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
replies.text:
The planet closest to the Sun is Mercury. It orbits our star at an average distance of about 58 million kilometers (36 million miles), completing its journey around the Sun in just over 88 Earth days. Because it has no atmosphere to retain heat, temperatures on Mercury can swing wildly between scorching highs during the day and freezing lows at night.

DONE
